name: TM39
description: Stops the foe from moving with rocks. May lower Speed.

gifts.note: Beat your Dad (Badge 5). The Petalburg Gym Leader battles you once you have the first four badges. After the battle you get TM Package 5 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and an Assault Vest. If your Bag had no room for the Assault Vest, talk to him again.

Beat the Rustboro Gym Leader (Badge 1). After the battle you get TM Package 1 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and an Eviolite. If your Bag had no room for the Eviolite, talk to the Leader again.
